authority_order: current explicit teacher instruction for the specific job
current Curriculum Philosophy PM for universal principles
current Physics Framework for Physics-specific behavior; ORIGINAL embedded Unit Assessment Plan is exact authority within the Framework for Unit Learning Targets/I-cans/Mastery Goals/evidence/scope
current executable task PM for procedure
assessment_plan_rule: ASSESSMENT PLAN IS KING for learning/evidence/scope. Framework may index it but never invent a competing curriculum sequence.
framework_rule: Framework owns Physics-specific response mix, course-resolved counts/coverage, conceptual-before-computational behavior, WTC implementation, contextual quantitative EX/YTI priority, physical-situation authoring, source hierarchy, visual-story Notes behavior, representations, exact Assessment Plans, course paths/integration, and downstream course profiles. It does not own universal Question Structure taxonomy, PM workflow/package procedure, Control Panel behavior, or generic renderer/tool mechanics.
source_rule: Extracted Conceptual Physics/Hewitt is primary conceptual/visual/question-family benchmark. Holt calibrates quantitative archetypes; OpenStax supports high-school explanation/representation; Halliday supports precision only. Sources enrich but do not expand course scope.
derivative_index_rule: If any derivative JSON/index conflicts with original Assessment Plan HTML, original HTML wins.
dashboard_rule: teacher_dashboard_reference.html is observed live-path evidence. Internal relative paths inform course_file_structure; stale external Algebra links/comments are flagged cleanup findings and never become Physics path authority.
stable_filename_rule: Canonical saved artifact filenames are stable/unversioned (for example Framework_Physics.zip). Internal framework_version metadata exists for diagnosis; do not choose authority by highest filename version.
delivery_rule: Current task PM and explicit teacher instruction own output/replacement packaging. Framework records only Physics-specific deployed-path/integration requirements.
map_first_repetition_rule: For multi-item authoring, map the full scope before authoring and repair template-driven repetition at the plan stage; purposeful repeated Physics families are allowed and there is no late anti-clone rewrite.
question_design_rule: Use current `_question_structure.zip` as universal design/variation authority before Physics prompt prose. Physics `question_design_map_contract.json`, Hewitt families, and section enrichment apply course-specific evidence/representation/context decisions without becoming a competing universal taxonomy.
task_pm_rule: Current task PM owns required-input resolution, validation sequence, assembly/audit workflow, packaging, and output.
